description: Links this connection to the person's own Precleared key, so checks use their own free allowance, 14-day trial starting with the first check, and plan instead of the shared free allowance. Use it when the person asks to sign in to or connect Precleared, or when contact_check says the free checks have run out. If they aren't signed in, Claude will ask them to sign in.
name: link_account
title: Sign in to Precleared
